annotations.description: Mulliganed a 7-card hand with 2 lands and multiple castable 3-drops. While the hand is light on lands and missing blue sources for Mistwalker/Gigantoplasm, it has a functional curve with Pridemalkin and Bloodline Pretender off just Forests, plus strong synergy with Wildwood Scourge. Going to 6 is a real cost.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. Pridemalkin and Bloodline Pretender are castable off Forests, and the synergy between Pridemalkin, Bloodline Pretender, and Wildwood Scourge is strong. Drawing into a 3rd land (especially a blue source) makes the hand excellent.

annotations.description: Kept a hand with 4 Snow-Covered Islands and zero black mana sources. Only 1 of 3 creatures (Chillerpillar) is castable, and not until turn 4. Fetid Imp and Kothophed both require black mana that isn't present. The hand is essentially a 1-spell hand that needs to naturally draw into an entirely different color to function.
annotations.actionTaken: Kept a hand with no black mana sources despite having 2 black spells (Fetid Imp and Kothophed).
annotations.betterLine: Mulligan to 6 and scry for a more functional hand with access to both colors, or at least a hand where more spells are castable.

annotations.description: Could have cast Chilling Trap targeting Universal Automaton (which is a Wizard due to Changeling) to draw a card for just {U}. The -4/-0 on the non-attacking Automaton is meaningless, making this essentially a 1-mana cantrip. However, saving the Trap for defensive use later is defensible.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Chilling Trap targeting Universal Automaton to draw a card, since the Automaton is a Wizard (Changeling) and the -4/-0 is irrelevant on a non-attacking 1/1

annotations.description: Passed on casting Chilling Trap with 1 untapped Island and no other uses for the mana. Universal Automaton has Changeling (is a Wizard), so Chilling Trap would cantrip (draw a card) for just {U}. The -4/-0 could target their own tapped creature with no downside since combat is over. This wastes a free card draw opportunity.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the turn with 1 unused mana.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Chilling Trap targeting own tapped Ironshell Beetle (or Universal Automaton) to draw a card for free, since Universal Automaton's Changeling makes it a Wizard.

annotations.description: Passed on casting Chilling Trap during combat when Universal Automaton (Changeling = Wizard) was on the battlefield, meaning it would cantrip. The -4/-0 on Chillerpillar is minor but the card draw for {U} is free value, and the Island mana would otherwise go unused this turn (no other plays available with 2 lands).
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting Chilling Trap
annotations.betterLine: Cast Chilling Trap targeting Chillerpillar to draw a card for {U}, since Universal Automaton counts as a Wizard and the mana would be wasted otherwise

annotations.description: Failed to block Universal Automaton (1/1) with Pilfering Hawk (1/2), which would have killed the Automaton for free while the Hawk survives. Instead took 3 damage unnecessarily when could have taken only 2 and removed an opposing creature.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block, taking 3 damage from both attackers.
annotations.betterLine: Block Universal Automaton with Pilfering Hawk - kills the 1/1, Hawk survives at 1/1, and only take 2 damage from Ironshell Beetle instead of 3.

annotations.description: Casting Heirloom Blade over Mistwalker when the opponent is at 10 life and GPT52 Humble needs evasive pressure. Mistwalker provides an immediate flying body that can attack past ground blockers and block Pilfering Hawk, while Heirloom Blade won't be equipped until next turn and doesn't add a body to the board.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Mistwalker for 2U, adding a 1/4 flying changeling that applies immediate evasive pressure against an opponent at 10 life and provides a relevant blocker

annotations.description: Put the +1/+1 counter on Universal Automaton (making it 2/2 trample) instead of Pridemalkin (which would become 3/2 trample). Both choices equally maximize Armorcraft Judge draws (2 creatures with counters), but Pridemalkin as a 3/2 trample is a meaningfully better attacker than a 2/2 Universal Automaton, especially with the opponent at 10 life and their creatures tapped.
annotations.actionTaken: Put the +1/+1 counter on Universal Automaton, making it a 2/2 with trample.
annotations.betterLine: Put the +1/+1 counter on Pridemalkin, making it a 3/2 with trample — a bigger threat that pressures the opponent's 10 life total more effectively while providing the same Armorcraft Judge synergy.

annotations.description: Attempted to activate Icebind Pillar to tap an attacker during combat but failed the mana payment, resulting in both attackers (2/2 Ironshell Beetle and 2/2 Universal Automaton with trample) dealing 4 damage unimpeded. At 10 life, preventing 2 of that damage was significant.
annotations.actionTaken: Tried to activate Icebind Pillar but the mana payment failed, so no action was taken and both attackers connected.
annotations.betterLine: Successfully activate Icebind Pillar using one of the three untapped Snow-Covered Islands to tap either the Ironshell Beetle or Universal Automaton, reducing incoming damage by 2.

annotations.description: Attacked with only Chillerpillar when the opponent had no untapped creatures to block. Pilfering Hawk could have attacked for 1 free damage (bringing opponent to 10 instead of 11). At 6 life, MstMed Optim is in a race and every point of damage matters.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only Chillerpillar for 3 damage
annotations.betterLine: Attack with both Chillerpillar and Pilfering Hawk for 4 total damage, since the opponent has zero untapped blockers. The Hawk's draw/discard ability is less valuable than 1 free damage in a race at 6 life.

annotations.description: MstMed Optim passed priority during combat with Chillerpillar attacking unblocked, missing the opportunity to activate Monstrosity ({4}{S}{S}) to make it 5/5 with flying, dealing 2 extra damage. They have exactly 6 mana available (5 Snow-Covered Islands + 1 Swamp) to pay the cost. The permanent flying is also valuable defensively. While this uses all mana preventing post-combat plays, the 2 extra damage and permanent flying on a 5/5 is significant when trying to close out the game.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority during combat, letting Chillerpillar deal only 3 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Chillerpillar's Monstrosity ability to make it 5/5 with flying, dealing 5 damage instead of 3 and gaining permanent evasion.

annotations.description: At 6 life facing potential lethal next turn (6 damage with trample from Pridemalkin's ability), spent all 6 mana on Chillerpillar Monstrosity (making it a tapped 5/5 flyer) instead of deploying defensive creatures. Opponent has 2/2 trample + 2/2 trample + 2/1 = 6 power, and MstMed only has Pilfering Hawk 1/2 and Icebind Pillar (tap one) to defend.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Chillerpillar Monstrosity for 6 mana, using all available mana on an offensive upgrade for an already-tapped creature.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Phyrexian Ironfoot (3 mana, 3/4 blocker) + Fetid Imp (1B, flying deathtouch blocker) for 5 mana, leaving 1 snow mana for Icebind Pillar activation. This provides three blockers (Ironfoot 3/4, Fetid Imp 1/2 deathtouch, Pilfering Hawk 1/2) plus Icebind Pillar tap, easily surviving the attack.

annotations.description: MstMed Optim is at 6 life facing 7 total power with trample (Universal Automaton 5/3 and Ironshell Beetle 2/2). By blocking Ironshell Beetle with Pilfering Hawk (1/2), the Beetle's 2 power exactly kills the 2-toughness Hawk with 0 trample overflow, reducing incoming damage to just 5 (from the unblocked Automaton). This would leave MstMed at 1 life instead of dying. The timeout/no-response meant no blocks were declared, taking the full 7 damage for lethal.
annotations.actionTaken: No blocks declared (timeout/no response), taking 7 damage and dying.
annotations.betterLine: Block Ironshell Beetle with Pilfering Hawk to reduce incoming damage to 5, surviving at 1 life. Then next turn, MstMed has removal spells (Demon's Grasp, Diabolic Edict) and powerful creatures (Kothophed) to potentially stabilize.
